Samples of Codex's and Cursor's server files for apps/cli/test/clients-codex.test.ts and clients-cursor.test.ts.
Every value is invented. The shapes are the clients' own documents' (Codex: ~/.codex/config.toml and a trusted
repository's .codex/config.toml, `[mcp_servers.<name>]` tables; Cursor: ~/.cursor/mcp.json and a repository's
.cursor/mcp.json, an `mcpServers` object). Neither client was installed on the machine these were written on, so no
real install was read: see the headers of apps/cli/src/clients/codex.ts and cursor.ts for what is not confirmed.
Claude Desktop's and VS Code's samples are in others/, for clients-others.test.ts, with their own README.
